fact: The Liberia Land Authority signed a three-year MOU with ALLFORLAND and LTMETRIC to develop the Liberia Land Information System, with a pilot in Montserrado and Margibi Counties expected within a few months.

The Liberia Land Authority and Liberia Revenue Authority are using a Real Property Valuation Software and Mobile App for GPS mapping and coding of properties in Nimba County, with over 12,000 properties mapped and data feeding a national cadastre.
system: Real Property Valuation Software and Mobile App
